title: HB919 (2018 Regular): Public Safety - Handgun Permit - Renewal

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Maryland) (gun-policy Stage 5, Maryland); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Mississippi text (First Reader; official copy, https://mgaleg.maryland.gov/2018RS/bills/hb/hb0919f.pdf)
provenance.note: First reader (as filed). Quotes drop bracketed (deleted) words: the renewal-training course and 'successive periods of 3 years each' are deleted. No passage vote on file.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5-306(a)(5)): (5) except as provided in subsection (b) of this section, has successfully completed prior to application, a firearms training course approved by the Secretary that includes: (i) a minimum of 16 hours of instruction by a qualified handgun instructor;
Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5-309(b)): (b) Subject to subsection (c) of this section, a permit may be renewed ONE TIME for A PERIOD OF 4 years if, at the time of THE application for renewal, the applicant possesses the qualifications for the issuance of a permit and pays the renewal fee stated in this subtitle.
